newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurer PZU mulls higher motor premiums.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurer PZU mulls higher motor premiums.

text.p: Poland's largest insurer Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen PZU SA (PZU) is considering raising next year automotive liability insurance premiums by 50 to 70 percent, a company official said on Tuesday.
"An increase of (obligatory motor insurance) premiums by 50 to 70 percent is under consideration," a company official, who requested anonymity, told Reuters.
Earlier the company has signalled that fast rising motor insurance claims were likely to force it increase premiums next year but so far PZU has not announced the scope of the increases.

The state-owned PZU, which together with its life subsidiary PZU Zycie SA controls 70 percent of Poland's insurance market, plans a partial privatisation next year through a new share issue for selected financial investors.
